content: Desktop notification patterns for terminal/agent tools: Warp fires on command completion, password/input prompts, agent errors; only fires when user is in different app. Click-to-focus: notification click navigates to session. DND: respects macOS System DND. User toggle in Settings. Warp agent notifications: 3 types - completion, user-input-required (blocked/waiting), errors. Claude Code community: hook-triggered bell/OSC sequences via tmux forwarded to iTerm2. Key deduplication principle: fire once on state TRANSITION to waiting, not on every poll tick. tap-to-tmux uses per-project cooldowns.
